title: Confirmed-Finding Variant Hunter
goal: After a finding is confirmed, automatically propose or queue safe variant checks across similar routes, parameters, objects, and contexts to discover related vulnerabilities.
scope: Variant candidate generation, safe follow-up proposal creation, runner selection, evidence traceability, and tests for confirmed-finding-driven variant analysis.
generation_reason: Evidence-first AI pentesting should exploit learning from confirmed findings: one XSS, IDOR, path traversal, auth, or upload weakness should trigger bounded search for sibling variants instead of ending at a single tool hit.

review_findings: Pivot Engine already queues follow-up scans from confirmed findings.
More discoveries require variant analysis around confirmed weakness patterns.
Variant hunting must remain approval-aware and evidence-backed.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: REQUIRES: backlog-337 pivot engine and current runner metadata

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Implement bounded variant discovery from confirmed findings. Do not auto-approve active/intrusive/destructive follow-ups.
constraints.approval_aware: Passive variant checks may follow existing dispatch rules; active or intrusive variants must remain review-gated proposals unless an existing approved policy explicitly allows them.

success_criteria: Confirmed findings produce variant candidates based on shared parameter names, route templates, object ID patterns, upload fields, reflected contexts, auth state, or technology signals.
Variant candidates include evidence refs to the source finding and the sibling surface that justifies the test.
The system deduplicates variants and avoids retesting already-covered surfaces.
Active/intrusive variant tests remain proposal-gated with clear rationale.
Tests prove a confirmed XSS/IDOR/path traversal style finding generates bounded sibling variant checks.

acceptance_criteria: Confirmed finding fixtures produce safe, deduplicated variant candidates with evidence refs.
Already tested sibling surfaces are skipped with rationale.
No live target testing or safety-boundary bypass occurs.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains in NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Auto-approving active, intrusive, exploit, or destructive actions.
Creating a second runtime binding or capability-pack lane.
